# Free Tier Hub

> Independent developer free-tier directory with usage caveats and official provider links.

## Primary resources
- [Directory](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/): first 12 catalog cards; full catalog is navigable through static category pages and limited offers.
- [All categories](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/categories/): all service categories with live counts and category landing pages.
- [Offer classifications](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/about/classifications/): definitions of plan, deployment, eligibility and verification labels.
- [Limited offers](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/offers/): time-limited promotions and expiring resources, excluded from primary counts.
- [Education benefits](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/education/): separate verified student and teacher programs, not counted as free-tier services.
- [Catalog JSON](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/catalog.json): machine-readable data with source URLs, review dates and plan types.
- [Sitemap](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml): all category and service canonical HTML URLs.
- [Agent discovery](https://free-tier.eplus.dev/agents.md): optional reading guide.

## Interpretation
- Home loads additional cards through JavaScript; for complete crawlable service links, follow the category pages and sitemap.
- All services includes limited and expiring offers; the free-tier count includes only ongoing allowances and recurring credits.
- An unknown card or commercial-use value means check the provider; it does not mean permission is granted.
- Official provider links in the JSON are the primary sources of current billing and limits.
- Review dates are editorial snapshots, not a guarantee that a provider has not changed its terms.
